description: Turn unstructured text into strict, machine-readable JSON for agent pipelines: a deterministic, reproducible alternative to an LLM extraction call. Extracts emails, URLs, EVM wallet addresses, transaction hashes, ISO-normalized dates, money amounts, percentages, phone numbers and key:value pairs from invoices, emails, messages, logs or documents. Pass fields or a JSON schema to receive exactly the fields you need. Same input, same output, in milliseconds.
name: text-to-structure
